description: Wild female Iberian Lynx ( Lynx pardinus ), Almuradiel, Ciudad Real , Spain. The Iberian lynx is one of the four extant species within the medium-sized wild cat genus Lynx. It is endemic to the Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe. It is listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List.
